items.exampleEn: I sometimes walk to work when the weather is nice.
items.exampleZh: 天氣好的時候，我有時候會走路上班。

items.exampleEn: Summer is the busiest season for hotels in Kenting.
items.exampleZh: 夏天是墾丁飯店最忙的季節。

items.exampleEn: Suddenly, all the lights in the office went out.
items.exampleZh: 突然間，辦公室所有的燈都熄了。

items.exampleEn: After waiting for an hour, we eventually got a table.
items.exampleZh: 等了一個小時後，我們終於有位子了。

items.exampleEn: Please call me immediately if the package arrives.
items.exampleZh: 包裹一到，請立刻打電話給我。

items.exampleEn: The previous owner of this car took good care of it.
items.exampleZh: 這輛車的前任車主很愛惜它。

items.exampleEn: The annual sale starts next Monday.
items.exampleZh: 年度特賣下星期一開始。

items.sentenceEn: The train stopped suddenly, and everyone looked up from their phones.
items.sentenceZh: 火車突然停下來，大家都從手機上抬起頭來。

items.audioEn: Our previous office was small, but the current one has a big kitchen.
items.audioZh: 我們先前的辦公室很小，但現在這間有一個大廚房。
items.questionZh: 說話者現在的辦公室有什麼？

items.sentenceEn: The company's annual party is usually held in December.
items.sentenceZh: 公司的年度派對通常在十二月舉行。

items.sentenceEn: The team worked hard and eventually finished the job.
items.sentenceZh: 這個團隊很努力，最後完成了工作。

items.stemEn: When the fire alarm rang, everyone left the building ____.
items.stemZh: 火災警報響起時，大家立刻離開了大樓。

items.stemEn: Spring is my favorite ____ because the weather is warm.
items.stemZh: 春天是我最喜歡的季節，因為天氣很溫暖。

items.passageEn: Tom's company holds its annual meeting every December, the busiest season of the year. This year, his manager suddenly had to fly to Japan, so Tom had to lead the meeting. Tom sometimes feels nervous in front of many people, so he immediately read the notes from the previous meeting and practiced at home. The meeting went well, and eventually his manager called to thank him. Tom now enjoys his current job even more.
items.passageZh: Tom 的公司每年十二月舉行年度會議，那是一年中最忙的季節。今年他的經理突然必須飛去日本，所以 Tom 得主持會議。Tom 在很多人面前有時候會緊張，所以他立刻讀了上次會議的筆記，並在家裡練習。會議很順利，最後經理打電話來謝謝他。Tom 現在更喜歡他目前的工作了。

questions.questionZh: Tom 為什麼要主持會議？
Tom 怎麼準備這場會議？
options: 讀上次會議筆記，在家練習
每天和同事一起練習報告
上網找別人做過的報告來看

items.promptZh: 他昨天聽到消息後，立刻回家了。
referenceEn: He went home immediately after he heard the news yesterday.
After hearing the news yesterday, he immediately went home.
rubricZh: immediately 表示「立刻」，可放在動詞前、句尾或句首（例如 Immediately after…）
「聽到消息後」可用 after＋子句或 after＋動名詞（例如 after he heard、after hearing）
昨天的事用過去式（例如 went、heard）

items.instructionZh: 用 sometimes 造一個句子，說說一件你有時候會做的事。
referenceEn: I sometimes cook dinner for my family.
Sometimes I read in bed until midnight.
rubricZh: 可放在一般動詞前、be 動詞後或句首（例如 I sometimes cook、Sometimes I go…）
說習慣多用現在簡單式，其他合理時態也接受
